original_query: select  i_item_desc       ,w_warehouse_name       ,d1.d_week_seq       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is null then 1 else 0 end) no_promo       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is not null then 1 else 0 end) promo       ,count(*) total_cnt from catalog_sales join inventory on (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) join warehouse on (w_warehouse_sk=inv_warehouse_sk) join item on (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) join customer_demographics on (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) join household_demographics on (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) join date_dim d1 on (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) join date_dim d2 on (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) join date_dim d3 on (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) left outer join promotion on (cs_promo_sk=p_promo_sk) left outer join catalog_returns on (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cr_order_number = cs_order_number) where d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq   and inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity   and d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'   and hd_buy_potential = '>10000'   and d1.d_year = 2001   and cd_marital_status = 'W'   and cd_dep_count between 4 and 6   and i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')   and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37 group by i_item_desc,w_warehouse_name,d1.d_week_seq order by total_cnt desc, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq limit 100;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    i_item_desc,
    w_warehouse_name,
    d1.d_week_seq,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cs_promo_sk IS NULL) AS no_promo,
    COUNT(cs_promo_sk) AS promo,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
JOIN date_dim d1
  ON d1.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d2
  ON d2.d_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d3
  ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_ship_date_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion p
  ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr
  ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
 AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
WHERE d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
  AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'
  AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
  AND d1.d_year = 2001
  AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
  AND cd.cd_dep_count BETWEEN 4 AND 6
  AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
  AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37
GROUP BY i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Remove the unused LEFT OUTER JOIN to catalog_returns: it contributes no columns to SELECT/WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY, and TPC-DS uniqueness on (cr_item_sk, cr_order_number) makes it cardinality-neutral. The optimizer plan already eliminates it.

Remove the LEFT OUTER JOIN to promotion. Since p_promo_sk is only tested for NULL/non-NULL and cs_promo_sk is a valid FK when non-NULL (TPC-DS referential integrity), cs_promo_sk IS NULL / IS NOT NULL gives the same result without the join.
Replace SUM(CASE WHEN ...) aggregates with COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cs_promo_sk IS NULL) and COUNT(cs_promo_sk) for clearer and slightly cheaper aggregation.

All filter predicates (d_year, hd_buy_potential, cd_marital_status, cd_dep_count, i_category, cs_wholesale_cost) are already selective and pushed down; no CTE is needed since there are no redundant subquery calculations.
